//! Writes a REAL v9 vault (storage format 9, whole-vault rewrite) plus an expectations file.
//! Run against the pre-WAL build: cargo run --example gen_v9_fixture -- <out_dir>
use secrecy::SecretString;
use vultrino::auth::{NewUseToken, UseToken};
use vultrino::policy::Policy;
use vultrino::storage::{FileStorage, StorageBackend};
use vultrino::{Credential, CredentialData, Secret};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let out = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::args().nth(1).unwrap());
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&out).unwrap();
    let path = out.join("vault.enc");
    let s = FileStorage::new(&path, &SecretString::from("fixture-pw")).await.unwrap();
    let mut aliases = vec![];
    for a in ["gh-main", "slack-bot"] {
        s.store(&Credential::new(a.to_string(), CredentialData::ApiKey {
            key: Secret::new(format!("sekret-{a}")),
            header_name: "Authorization".into(),
            header_prefix: "Bearer ".into(),
        })).await.unwrap();
        aliases.push(a);
    }
    let mut token_ids = vec![];
    for i in 0..3 {
        let (_p, t) = UseToken::create(NewUseToken {
            name: format!("fixture-tok-{i}"), credential_scope: "*".into(), action_scope: None,
            max_uses: Some(5), require_approval: false, expires_in: None,
        });
        token_ids.push(t.id.clone());
        s.store_use_token(&t).await.unwrap();
    }
    s.store_policy(&Policy::allow_all("fixture-allow", "gh-*")).await.unwrap();
    // A kill that is later lifted (leaves a mark) and a kill that stays stored.
    let mut lifted = Policy::allow_all("lifted", "slack-*");
    lifted.id = "kill-lifted".into(); lifted.kill = true;
    s.store_policy(&lifted).await.unwrap();
    s.delete_policy("kill-lifted").await.unwrap();
    let mut live = Policy::allow_all("live", "gh-*");
    live.id = "kill-live".into(); live.kill = true; live.principal_pattern = Some("agent-7".into());
    s.store_policy(&live).await.unwrap();
    let exp = serde_json::json!({
        "password": "fixture-pw", "aliases": aliases, "token_ids": token_ids,
        "policy_ids": ["kill-live"], "allow_policy_name": "fixture-allow",
        "kill_epoch": s.kill_fence_epoch().await,
        "lifted_mark_id": "kill-lifted", "live_kill_id": "kill-live",
    });
    std::fs::write(out.join("expected.json"), serde_json::to_string_pretty(&exp).unwrap()).unwrap();
    println!("{exp}");
}
